gaps.sentence: Don't leave ___ any details in your report.

gaps.explanation: branch out = start doing something new and different.

gaps.sentence: Small suppliers are struggling to keep their heads ___ water.
gaps.explanation: 'Keep your head above water' = just manage to survive, especially financially.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
To sum ___, we need more time and a bigger budget.
gaps.explanation: sum up = summarize the main points.

gaps.sentence: Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).

gaps.sentence: The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
They set ___ to climb the north face in April.
gaps.explanation: set out (to do) = begin a job/mission with a goal.
